issues.title: BLU-053 seeded fuzzing of event normalization (partial)

criteria.requirement: No crashes or secret persistence across the complete event and storage pipeline
criteria.reason: Fuzzing covers pure normalizer, decoder and OCR gate only; persistent storage, real screen frames and the native pipeline are not exercised.

criteria.requirement: Pure normalization, parsing and OCR gates tolerate malformed and oversized input without unexpected exceptions

tests.name: arbitrary text only ever fails with ActivityStepFormatException
garbage text and metadata never throw; fake secrets always deny
maximum-length repetitive input completes and is classified

criteria.requirement: Seeded pure-code fuzz cases reproduce traces and reject malformed records with typed failures

tests.name: the same seed gives the identical retained trace
different seeds actually exercise different streams
valid steps round-trip and random mutations never escape typed

criteria.requirement: No real secrets, personal data, raw screenshots or unapproved network egress in production paths and CI artifacts
criteria.reason: Fabricated local unit inputs do not prove end-to-end log/artifact scrubbing, screenshot handling or network isolation; require full pipeline evidence.

criteria.requirement: Pure OCR gate denies unverified, blank, oversized and fake-token-bearing text

tests.name: unverified, blank and oversized OCR is never allowed
garbage text and metadata never throw; fake secrets always deny

criteria.requirement: Backwards compatibility, native Android/iOS/macOS behavior and capabilities are reviewed
criteria.reason: Pure Dart unit fuzz cases are not proof of platform integration, physical host permissions, device behavior or backwards compatibility; maintainer review and appropriate integration checks remain required.
